title: prunella vulgaris var. violacea
intro: Prunella vulgaris var. violacea, commonly known as self-heal violet or violet self-heal, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Prunella vulgaris var. violacea include wound healing, immune system stimulation, and protection against infections, making it a popular natural remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
